_readme: How Office_Level3 starts (Level3OfficeStart). Office_Level3 is a one-time copy of the saved Office_Level2 (T02); Rosa's Level 2 parts are built at runtime only in Office_Level2, so none of them exist here. The copy still holds Level 1's plaza quest crowd, corkboard side quest and popup tutorial, switched off below.
spawn / face / blend: the same reception placement as Level 2 (about 1 m inside the street entrance, facing the receptionist).
hide: scene objects switched off before anything starts (deactivated, never deleted). Office_Level1 and Office_Level2 are not touched.
disableComponents: component class names switched off in this scene before they start.

receptionHistory: the receptionist's first line ({history} in case_bea_001's greeting), chosen from the saved Rosa history (CONTENT 'First reception'). Read only: no Rosa consequence is applied again.
Fields starting with '_' are notes and are ignored by the game.
_hide: Level 1's plaza quest crowd (NPCS, including Marie and the tutorial guide), the corkboard side quest, the Client IDs icon and the waiting-area copy of Marie. Bea's plaza table arrives with T04.
_disableComponents: TutorialController: Level 1's tutorial. StampSetInteractable (T09): the inherited Level 1 stamp set would open Level 1's stamp flow; Bea's sheet has its own desk stamps standing on the same stand (Level3DeskCalculatorReview).
_hideDeskFolder: The desk Case Folder would open Level 1's folder flow; it is hidden the same way Level 2 hides it before retrieval (CaseFolder3DDrag.HideAndDisableFolder). Later tickets hand Bea's papers over their own way.
